covered.name: Repeated-task learning
covered.pass_criterion: A repeated task family yields an actionable, non-authoritative compiled capability whose holdout cost falls (cost_improvement_ratio < 1.0) while verified correctness stays within threshold (correctness_ratio >= 0.90).

covered.name: Evolution rollback
covered.pass_criterion: When a promoted canary regresses at ACTIVE, the router downgrades it to CANARY and restores the exact prior certified route, matching the declared chaos expectation field-for-field.

covered.name: 2G benchmark reproducibility
covered.pass_criterion: The checked-in native-runtime benchmark artifact loads from disk and two executions reproduce identical results and run digests. This does NOT open the frozen INV-020 superiority gate.
